I wasn't able to generate that exact image as described.

I can still help with a safer version that keeps your core idea intact if you'd like:

A genuinely vertical 9:16 photorealistic-natural editorial in the Italian Garden — clipped hedges, geometric flower beds, tall palms, stone balustrades and layered wooded slopes dominating, with a broad dry terrace, heavy rain curtain in the background, and a glass civilian polar-airship gondola with luminous navigation instruments on a separate research pad.

Four distinct fictional adults age 21 — Alia with voluminous curls, Radiance blonde, Ellie and AI ECE dark-haired — preserved as distinct anchored faces from your three references, all standing together in an extreme-wide environmental composition where the garden and gondola dominate and all four complete bodies and footwear are visible.

Four coordinated but unrelated fully-clothed looks with secure opaque hemlines — garden-emerald lace, gallery-burgundy satin, aurora-cyan + polar-silver two-piece, and airship-charcoal + pearl-white two-piece — no hosiery, with four botanical aurora keys aligned around one inert cyan-brass route beacon held with both hands by AI ECE, in a collaborative research moment.

No lap sitting, no linked-hand choice or jealous eye-line dynamic — just the four colleagues sharing the navigation find.

Would you like me to create that version?
